h1: FunPlay's Innovative Approach to Playground Design

props.title: FunPlay's Innovative Approach to Playground Design
props.summaryText: The principles that guide every FunPlay design: fit the site, offer many ways to play, mix play and learning, draw on Indian culture and nature, and build for Indian weather.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Child hanging from a rope at a playground, smiling

takeaways.text: We design for the specific site and users, not one size for all.
High play value: many activities and ways to play in each structure.
Play and learning together: counting, shapes, music and stories built into equipment.
Inspired by Indian culture and nature, and built for Indian sun, rain and heavy use.

faq.q: What makes FunPlay's playground designs different?
faq.a: We design for the site and its users, aim for high play value, combine play with learning, draw on Indian culture and nature, and build for Indian conditions with in-house manufacturing in Vasai, near Mumbai.

faq.q: Does FunPlay make playground equipment for all ages?
faq.a: Yes, from toddler play units and spring riders to adventure structures for older children and outdoor gym equipment for teenagers and adults.
